name: PDF Preview Image
description: Autogenerates PDF preview into an image field.
project_description: PDF Preview Image auto-generates a preview image of the first page of an uploaded PDF and stores it in a separate image field on the same entity. It has no admin UI, routes, or permissions of its own: it works by adding two third-party settings (an 'enable' checkbox and a 'target image field' selector) to the Field UI edit form of any core file field whose Allowed file extensions include 'pdf', and by rendering the preview during hook_entity_presave(). It requires the spatie/pdf-to-image Composer package (v3.x, pulled in automatically with the module), which uses the Imagick PHP extension; ImageMagick must be built with PDF (Ghostscript) delegate support on the server. Version 3.x rasterises PDFs through the Imagick PHP extension rather than shelling out to a command-line binary.
